result.instructions: Tools for Facturama, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my invoices issued this month are still active, and for which customers?"; "Download the PDF of invoice folio 1024 so I can send it to the customer."; "Find the SAT product code for software licences and add it to my product catalog.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Facturama data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run facturama_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run facturama_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run facturama_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. facturama_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: facturama_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the receivers (clients) in the Facturama client catalog, a page at a time, optionally filtered by a search text. Each client has Id, Rfc, Name, FiscalRegime, CfdiUse and TaxZipCode. Facturama API: GET /clients.

search.description: Text to search for (name, RFC, or key word).

start.description: Position of the first record (0 = first). Default 0.

tools.name: facturama_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client of the catalog by its Facturama id, with its fiscal data and address. Facturama API: GET /Client/{Id}.

tools.name: facturama_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products and services in the Facturama product catalog, a page at a time, optionally filtered by a search text. Each item has Id, Name, Description, Price, CodeProdServ, UnitCode and Taxes. Facturama API: GET /products.

search.description: Text to search for (name, RFC, or key word).

start.description: Position of the first record (0 = first). Default 0.

tools.name: facturama_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product or service of the catalog by its Facturama id. Facturama API: GET /Product/{Id}.

tools.name: facturama_search_sat_product_codes
tools.title: Search SAT product codes
tools.description: Search the SAT product and service catalog (ClaveProdServ) by a key word, for example 'software'. Use the returned code as CodeProdServ of a product. Facturama API: GET /catalogs/ProductsOrServices?keyword=.

keyword.description: Key word to search for, for example 'software'.

tools.name: facturama_search_sat_units
tools.title: Search SAT units
tools.description: Search the SAT unit catalog (ClaveUnidad) by a key word, for example 'kilogramo' or 'servicio'. Use the returned code as UnitCode of a product. Facturama API: GET /catalogs/Units?keyword=.

keyword.description: Key word to search for, for example 'servicio'.

tools.name: facturama_list_cfdis
tools.title: List issued CFDIs
tools.description: List the CFDIs (invoices) issued through the Facturama web API, one page of 10 at a time, with filters for status, folio range, issue date range, receiver name, series, and payment method. Only documents issued through the API appear. Facturama API: GET /cfdi?type=issued.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (10 results per page). Default 0.

folio.description: Exact folio. Do not combine with folio_start or folio_end.

receiver_name.description: Receiver name or part of it (taxEntityName).

payment_method.description: Payment method: PUE (single payment) or PPD (deferred).

tools.name: facturama_get_cfdi
tools.title: Get a CFDI
tools.description: Get the summary of one CFDI by its Facturama id, with its status, folio, receiver, totals and UUID. Type is issued, received or payroll. Facturama API: GET /cfdi/{Id}?type=.

tools.name: facturama_download_cfdi
tools.title: Download a CFDI file
tools.description: Download the XML or PDF file of one CFDI. XML is returned as readable text; PDF and HTML are returned as base64 content. Facturama API: GET /cfdi/{format}/{type}/{Id}.

tools.name: facturama_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a receiver (client) in the Facturama client catalog. It does not issue any CFDI. Facturama API: POST /Client. Use facturama_list_clients first to avoid a duplicate RFC.

rfc.description: RFC of the receiver. Use XAXX010101000 for the general public.

name.description: Name or company name of the receiver, as in the tax registry.

fiscal_regime.description: SAT fiscal regime key of the receiver, for example 601.

email.description: Main e-mail address of the receiver.

cfdi_use.description: SAT CFDI use key, for example G01.

tax_zip_code.description: Postal code of the receiver's tax address.

email_2.description: Second e-mail address of the receiver.

country.description: Country of the address, for example Mex.

tools.name: facturama_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a product or service in the Facturama product catalog. It does not issue any CFDI. Facturama API: POST /Product. Use facturama_search_sat_product_codes and facturama_search_sat_units to find the SAT keys first.

name.description: Name of the product or service.

description.description: Description printed on the invoice line.

product_code.description: SAT product or service key (ClaveProdServ), for example 81111500.

unit_code.description: SAT unit key (ClaveUnidad), for example E48 (service unit) or H87 (piece).

unit.description: Unit name printed on the invoice, for example Servicio or Pieza.

object_tax.description: SAT tax object key (ObjetoImp), for example 02 (taxable).

identification_number.description: Your internal product number or serial.

taxes.description: Taxes that apply to the product.

rate.description: Rate as a fraction, for example 0.16 for 16%.

is_federal_tax.description: True for a federal tax. Default true.

is_quota.description: True for a fixed amount per unit (IEPS quota).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Facturama
prompts.description: What you can do with Facturama here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_invoices_issued_this_month
prompts.title: Find invoices issued this month
prompts.description: List issued CFDIs ten at a time, filtered by status, folio range, issue date, receiver name, series or payment method. Only documents issued through the API appear.

prompts.name: download_an_invoice_as_pdf_or_xml
prompts.title: Download an invoice as PDF or XML
prompts.description: Download the XML or PDF file of one CFDI. The XML comes back as text. The PDF comes back as base64 content.

prompts.name: find_sat_codes_for_a_product
prompts.title: Find SAT codes for a product
prompts.description: Search the SAT product and unit catalogs by keyword, for example software or service. Use the codes on a new product.

prompts.name: review_the_client_and_product_catalogs
prompts.title: Review the client and product catalogs
prompts.description: List clients and products, a page at a time, with a search text. Open one to see its fiscal data, address or price.

prompts.name: add_a_client_or_product_to_the_catalog
prompts.title: Add a client or product to the catalog
prompts.description: Search the client list first to avoid a duplicate RFC, then create the client or product. Neither one issues an invoice.
